mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS (product of z-scores) fails to predict returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window, or negative signal occurs in <40% of instances where both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), further unemployment increases signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 900.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate policy response to inflation that increases real interest rates, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS (product of z-scores) fails to predict returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window, or negative signal occurs in <40% of instances where both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: In expansionary economic regimes (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% annualized), strong retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 90th percentile and GDPC1 growth > 1.0% (annualized), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
